payload.description: fgos git recover keeps a Land RefUpdate as ref-effect-unknown forever when its candidate is already an ancestor of the target, and every later land by that writer refuses resource-recovery-required. Seen on design-lap 2026-11-22: operation land-1103502-1795339603616361687-8 (writer f3456e8e), only pin refs/fgos/git-operations/<id>/candidate -> 50031ae58, which main reached through an ordinary ff of origin/main (reflog main@{21}); recover keeps it on every run and no door settles it. Expected: when the target ref already contains the candidate, recover settles the operation (effect present) or offers an explicit settle door; it must not block the writer's lands indefinitely.
